VERSION 3.28.0.172

; Only launch AppLoad. Networking and connection display stay in its application.
; Firmware stock binary SHA256 b1816408cf90b19e448c70082625c4d6a36060368706eb7a9b35425428a9a021.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Sidebar.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.AppLoad 1.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        TRAVERSE ColumnLayout#filterColumn
            LOCATE BEFORE Common.Background#spacer
            INSERT {
                ArkControls.SidebarItem {
                    objectName: "pi-annotations-sidebar"
                    text: "Pi Annotations"
                    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/link"
                    Layout.preferredWidth: parent.width
                    onClicked: {
                        root.hide();
                        AppLoadLauncher.launchApplication("org.pi-ink.annotations", [], {}, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
